reviews.text: As a pet owner, as all of you reading this review very well know, receiving adequate vet care is practically impossible in Montreal. As a skeptic of the system, I was wary that this last "vet" experience could be agonizing and make the last moments with my 18yr old Luna Bear (cat) a stressful goodbye. On the contrary, I'm happy to share that the kind-hearted staff at VetChezVous are truly empathetic, and Dr. Dahan was more than perfect in her approach. The whole ceremony was wholesome and peaceful. I thank all the staff for their support, seamless communication, and operations.
We extend our warmest thanks to the team at Vet chez vous. The veterinarian and staff demonstrated profound respect, kindness, and great sensitivity during this difficult time.

Our little Boo was never a fan of cars, and so for the final year of her life, we opted for at-home examinations. The team, particularly Dre Fernando, were always extremely insightful and caring towards her, and it was always a pleasure to see them. In Boo's final moments, we were touched by the care and consideration that went into the ethanasia service at home. I would strongly recommend this service when the time comes for your own little darlings, as it is much less stressful and a much more personal experience when done at home, particularly for them. Thank you, Vet Chez Vous.

Thank you so much for your incredible kindness and compassion during one of the hardest days of our lives. You were so gentle with our dogexplained everything clearly and made the entire process as peaceful as possible. Your care and empathy meant more to our family than words can express. We are truly grateful. We are also still using their amazing services for our new dog, and continue to be just as impressed by their care and professionalism. Can’t recommend them enough❤️❤️

I wholeheartedly recommend Vet Chez Vous for in-home pet euthanasia.

Dr. Dahan demonstrated immense gentleness, compassion, and professionalism throughout this extremely difficult ordeal.

One of the things that particularly touched me was how she approached Mouki. Knowing he had barely eaten anything for three days, she offered him a small portion of pâté, which he ate with gusto. While he was enjoying this moment of pleasure, she administered the sedative gently, without any stress or startle. Mouki remained calm and relaxed.

A few minutes later, when he left his heated mat to lie down on my side of the bed, Dr. Dahan respected his choice and asked if I wanted him moved. I replied that I didn't: this was where Mouki had chosen to be. This attention to detail and respect for my beloved cat's well-being deeply touched me.

After his peaceful passing, Dr. Dahan discreetly withdrew to give me some time alone with Mouki.

Afterward, she offered to take photos of Mouki and me. In my distress, I would never have thought to ask for such mementos. She also took a small lock of his fur, at my request.

Throughout the entire process, I felt respected and supported. The team also took the time to address my requests regarding individual cremation and memorial inscriptions, ensuring that my wishes were conveyed and respected.

Losing Mouki is one of the greatest sorrows of my life, but thanks to the kindness and professionalism of Dr. Dahan and the Vet Chez Vous team, his passing was gentle, dignified, and filled with love.

Thank you with all my heart,

Marie-Anne Jean

Thank you from the bottom of my heart,

Marie-Anne Jean

My cat recently had a very rapid deterioration a few days after being tested and given medication in hopes of improvement at my usual Clinic. They agreed to do a euthanasea later that evening. However I'm in a wheelchair after a recent Stroke! Getting down several flights of stairs, finding a taxi that could put my chair in their trunk - etc. just made it more stressful for us. The clinic gave us an outdated list of at-home end-of-life providers, incl. ones that could not come until the next day. I've already witnessed felines die in agony waiting to be seen and could not bear the thought of my gentle friend having to suffer another night! I went online and found Dr. Dahan of Vet-Chez-Vous & she was an absolute Angel. Not only was she able to come within the hour. she was gentle, compassionate & soothing. It was evident she knew how to handle animals with ease & grace. My cat was hardly anxious as she administered the first injection to relax & numb him. I held him in my arms and he transitioned peacefully in our bed. Plus her staff has the same empathy and kindness, creaing a seamless process throughout. I will definitely call Vet Chez Vous for examinations in the future.

Highly professional veterinarians, and on top of that, empathetic and comforting people. My dog ​​had a peaceful and relaxing end on her favorite outdoor sofa. I felt her relaxed and free from pain long before her final passing, and we were able to enjoy that moment with her for several minutes.

I recommend this service if you can.

Thank you to the Vet Chez Vous team.
Sensitive and appropriate service, thank you for your support during my cat's end of life <3

Perfect care from beginning to end, despite the difficult situation. The entire team was gentle, professional, respectful, and incredibly kind to our cat Maxime and our family. The fact that he was able to pass away peacefully at home, in his familiar surroundings, made all the difference to us. We felt supported and cared for every step of the way. Thank you so much for your compassion, your kindness, and your excellent service. 💜
My cats HATE going to the Vet, so Vet Chez Vous was the perfect service for us. Super reliable and very friendly.

I was looking for a veterinarian for in-home euthanasia, I contacted Vet Chez Vous and received impeccable service; they are understanding and caring people.

A trustworthy place.
So convenient and amazing service!!!!

Pet chez offers the best veterinary service in the city! Always gentle, punctual and make appointments fast and easy!
My dog loves them!

I cannot recommend Vet Chez Vous highly enough. Their team is exceptionally professional, compassionate, and knowledgeable. Having a veterinarian come directly to our home made the entire experience much less stressful for both our pet and our family.

The veterinarian ( Danna) took the time to thoroughly examine our pet, answer all of our questions, and explain everything clearly and patiently. It was evident that they genuinely care about the well-being of animals and treat each pet with kindness and respect.The service was punctual, organized, and delivered with the highest level of professionalism.

If you are looking for a trustworthy, caring, and highly competent veterinary service, I wholeheartedly recommend Vet Chez Vous. They provide outstanding care and truly go above and beyond.

Our experience with Vet Chez Vous has been absolutely amazing. They take such great care of our new puppy, Goldie and anytime we have questions, they respond promptly.

What really stands out is the personal relationship and level of care they provide, it’s reassuring to know your vet truly takes the time to support you and your pet every step of the way. We couldn’t be happier with the experience so far.

I had to have my cat euthanized, and I wanted him to spend his final days at home. I was hoping for compassion from the vet, but I didn't know what to expect. Wow! What compassion, what sensitivity from Catherine and Laura in their communications (so rare and precious these days!), and from Dr. Dana, the veterinarian! This sad day for my girlfriend and me will nonetheless remain a moment when my cat and my partner received ABSOLUTELY EVERYTHING WE NEEDED to get through this difficult time. What compassion! What sensitivity! Thank you to the three of you, and therefore to Vet Chez Vous! Incredible. No exaggeration here. All animals should benefit from this kind of attention at the end. A service that is far too rare!

As sad as the day was
The veterinarian was very kind, patient and friendly.
I'm happy Squishy was able to pass so quietly and comfortably.
A compassionate team that guided us throughout the euthanasia process for our cat, thank you very much.
Sadly had to say goodbye to my cat, VCV were the right choice. Caring, kind and their home service made one of the most awful days I'll remember into something bearable. Kind and professional.

This review is way late and overdue. My situation happened 4 years ago… I had my senior cat who rapidly declined during covid. I was new to my area and no vets were taking new patients. I was extremely distraught and emotional when I called Vet Chez Vous and was met with such kindness. They asked me a few questions even offered to examine Charlie and treat her if they could, but I knew it was time to let her go. They were able to fit me in the same day, the Vet gave her an exam and assured me that I was doing the right thing. The Vet and her tech took their time, explained each step and did not proceed until I was ready. They gave me the space and time to say my goodbyes. It was one of hardest days of my life and I could not imagine doing it in a vet clinic. I will forever be grateful of them coming to my house and allowing my girl to in her own surroundings.
